metadata.title: Finding Wills in England and Wales Online, Part 3: Ecclesiastical Probate Courts, pre-1858 (3-24)
metadata.author: BYU Library Family History Center
metadata.shortDescription:
Complete class name: Finding Wills in England and Wales Online, Part 3: Ecclesiastical Probate Courts, pre-1858 – Vivien Brown (24 Mar 2024)

Vivien Brown explains the Lower Ecclesiastical Courts at a more local level and what records might be available through them. She carefully explains what might be found in probate records and wills that will be useful in family history research. She also demonstrates different way to find these records.

For more information: https://familyhistory.lib.byu.edu/virtual-classes/finding-wills-in-england-and-wales-online-part-3-ecclesiastical-probate-courts-pre-1858

Slide Deck and Class Links: https://familyhistory.lib.byu.edu/virtual-classes/finding-wills-in-england-and-wales-online-part-3-ecclesiastical-probate-courts-pre-1858
